title: Tiny Snakes Cartwheel Away From Danger
paragraphs: Some small snakes in Asia can roll. They are dwarf reed snakes. They are about 30 centimetres long.
Scientists in Japan filmed 13 of these snakes. All 13 snakes rolled on the ground. They did not just slide.
A rolling snake is about four times faster than a sliding snake. The head stays still. The snake can see where it goes.
